model.name: diffEditor.connectorRibbons
model.description: Draw colored diagonal filled SVG ribbons in each inter-pane gutter linking a changed source block (Local for Gutter A, Repo for Gutter B, ranges via diffIndices) to its landing rows in Result; Y via getTopForLineNumber-getScrollTop; blue=non-conflict, green=resolvable, red/brown=conflict/deletion; redraw scroll-synced (via syncScroll3, rAF-throttled) + on resize/rebuildCenter.
